latin: Esse non est de quiditate dei, sed dicitur de eo in secundo modo.
latin_note: 1487 apparatus transposes the word order to 'Esse non de est quiditate' (farmer1998:12084); sense unaffected.
translation: Existence is no part of God's quiddity, but is predicated of him according to the second mode of per se predication.
translation_note: For the 'second mode' of predication, see the note to 2.24/2.35. Sense checked against farmer1998:12109.
